title: AI & LLM Integration for Java
intro: LLM-powered Spring applications are the newest backend interview surface. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with what Spring AI is and how it fits the Spring ecosystem, then prompt engineering (the lever you control), then wiring LLM APIs into a Spring app (rate limits, retries, function calling). From there it moves to RAG — the architecture most production LLM features use — and the vector databases that back it. It closes with the two tiers that separate shipped from demo: testing LLM features (evaluation, mocking) and observing them in production (cost, metrics, tracing).
